answer.reason: The value listed for IPP & CHP in Table 1 is the smaller, specific net generation figure; the larger option represents total net generation across all producer types.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Florida Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 16,588,495 megawatthours
B. 249,530,741 megawatthours

Source citation: Florida Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/florida/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: B
